notes.title: Patch Notes!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/2b7ea4bb73d9c783b23580c75d77a4c6e2c18e31.png[/img]

Hey Beans!

We released a patch today that solved two issues:

[b]Fixed[/b]: [i]Among Us 3D[/i] players can lose their HUD if they leave the wardrobe before another match starts.

Now you won't be ejected out of gameplay when you're trying to swag up. 


[b]Fixed[/b]: Kids Web Services (KWS)  ID will be displayed during confirmation process. 
We're continuing to look into the KWS concerns, so please continue to submit tickets if you're running into issues.

Stay Suspicious!
